ws.deck.question: Question
ws.deck.importHelp: One card per line: question | answer
ws.deck.emptyText: A few good questions are all you need to begin.
ws.deck.typePlaceholder: Type it, or just think it…
ws.recall.hint: Close the book, answer from memory, then check.
ws.recall.tip: Tip: ask “why” and “what if” questions, not only definitions.
ws.recall.noneInTopic: No cards on this topic yet.
ws.recall.askSure: Say how sure I am before I look
ws.recall.doneText: You recalled {got} of {n}. Every miss you found is one you can fix.
ws.recall.confidentWrongText: These matter most: they are hidden mix-ups. Read the answers again slowly and come back to them tomorrow.
ws.recall.noConfidentWrong: No confident mistakes. Your sense of what you know is on track. 🧭
ws.srs.hint: Review each card just as it starts to fade.
ws.srs.dueText: A few minutes now saves hours later.
ws.srs.nothingDueText: Your cards are resting. Let a little forgetting happen.
ws.srs.howBoxes: Right moves a card one box up and it waits longer. Missed sends it back to the first box.
ws.srs.doneText: {got} of {n} right. The rest will come back sooner.
ws.interleave.hint: Mix related topics, and name each one before answering.
ws.interleave.pickLede: Pick two or more topics that are easy to confuse.
ws.interleave.needTopics: Tip: give your cards a topic so there is something to mix.
ws.interleave.why: It will feel slower than one topic at a time. That is the point. 🐢
ws.interleave.doneText: Telling topics apart is a skill of its own, and it grows with each mix.
ws.pretest.hint: Guess before you study, then see what surprised you.
ws.pretest.lede: Wrong guesses are welcome here. They make the real answer stick. 🎯
ws.pretest.topicQ: What are you about to study?
ws.pretest.questionsLabel: Two or three questions, one per line
ws.pretest.questionsHelp: Use the end-of-chapter questions, the learning objectives, or your own hunches.
ws.pretest.fromCards: Use my cards on this topic
ws.pretest.noCards: No cards on this topic yet
ws.pretest.guessLede: A few seconds each. Being wrong is the point.
ws.pretest.lockedText: Now study {topic} and watch for the answers. Locked on {date}.
ws.pretest.compareLede: Put each guess next to the answer. Tick what surprised you.
ws.pretest.surprises.one: {n} surprise. Those are the ones that stick.
ws.pretest.surprises.few: {n} surprises. Those are the ones that stick.
ws.pretest.surprises.many: {n} surprises. Those are the ones that stick.
ws.pretest.surprises.other: {n} surprises. Those are the ones that stick.
ws.pretest.noSurprises: No surprises this time. Good hunches!
ws.relearn.hint: Recall each card until it is right, then again on later days.
ws.relearn.lede: Pick a set of cards. Each session ends when every card was right once. 🌱
ws.relearn.deleteTitle: Delete this set? The cards stay.
ws.relearn.how: Sessions come back after 1, 3, 7, then 14 days.
